summary: Sticky headers, cookie banners, and floating ads are now captured once instead of repeating down every full-page screenshot, and the floating panel no longer disappears when your capture history is empty.
highlights: Fixed/sticky elements captured once
Panel stays open on empty history
Clearer Copy as Prompt mode limits

summary: A new "Copy as Prompt" output mode lets you copy an element's context straight to your clipboard for AI coding tools, full-page capture is back to a debugger-free engine, and the floating panel gets animated toggles and more reliable capture hygiene.
highlights: Copy as Prompt output mode
Debugger-free full-page capture
Remove All from capture history
Interactive playground page

summary: Capture previews and a session history browser let you review, re-download, or copy recent screenshots without recapturing — plus a new CDP-based full-page engine that's dramatically faster with no stitching artifacts.
highlights: macOS-style capture preview thumbnail
Session-scoped capture history browser
Remove individual captures from history
Single-shot CDP full-page capture

summary: Major update introducing a persistent floating panel, configurable keyboard shortcuts, and click-and-drag area capture for a more flexible and powerful screenshot workflow.
highlights: Persistent floating in-page panel
Configurable keyboard shortcuts
Click-and-drag area capture
Renamed action buttons: Area, Screen, Page

summary: This update improves the element selection experience with smarter highlighting, a new Escape key to cancel, and better handling for oversized elements.
highlights: Cancel selection with Escape key
Smart highlight overlay for precise selection
Better handling of oversized elements

summary: This update focuses on streamlining the user interface and improving the overall user experience with a cleaner, more modern design.
highlights: Redesigned Popup UI with dark theme
Dedicated sliding settings panel
Visual enhancements to switches and sliders

summary: This update introduces new quick action buttons, clipboard support, dynamic capture delay, and improved scrolling capabilities for capturing large elements.
highlights: Quick action buttons for viewport and full page capture
Copy directly to clipboard to skip downloads
Dynamic delayed capture (0-10 seconds) for hover states

summary: This quality-of-life update features a redesigned settings panel and resolves issues with clipboard output and multi-tile stitching.
highlights: Redesigned settings panel with compact layout
Fixed issues with multi-tile image capture
Fixed clipboard output for viewport shortcuts

summary: The initial launch of Element Snapper! A powerful new extension to grab pixel-perfect screenshots of any webpage element.
highlights: Element selection capture with DPR-aware cropping
Full element capture utilizing multi-tile stitching
Lossless PNG and configurable JPEG support
